original:
I’m excited to share that I’ve officially wrapped up my Software Engineering Internship at NVIDIA!
This summer gave me the opportunity to work alongside incredibly talented engineers and contribute to projects that challenged me to think differently about software development. I spent a lot of time writing and debugging code, working through technical problems, reviewing existing systems, and learning how software is developed at a much larger scale than anything I had experienced before.
One of the biggest things I took away from the internship was how important collaboration is in engineering. Writing good code matters, but being able to explain your ideas, ask the right questions, understand feedback, and work through problems with a team is just as important.
I also gained a much better understanding of what goes into building reliable and high-performance software. There were plenty of moments where I didn’t immediately know the answer, but those ended up being some of the best learning experiences because they forced me to dig deeper and become more comfortable figuring things out on my own.
I’m extremely grateful to everyone at NVIDIA who answered my questions, reviewed my work, and helped me grow throughout the internship.
I’m leaving this experience as a much stronger developer and even more excited about continuing my career in software engineering.
Thank you to everyone who made this experience possible!
